title: Overture of the Final Act
next_chapter_hook: The messenger of the Heavenly Eye is about to speak, and Chen Ji feels the contract seal on his chest burning like fire—the final three paths have already been laid out before his feet.

text.content: In the instant the contract seal spread from his chest to every limb, Chen Ji felt the entire world trembling. A low sigh from the depths of the Void thundered in his ears, followed by an eye of immense size, impossible to measure, appearing through a crack in the blue sky—that was the true form of the Heavenly Eye. It was pitch black, with only the depths of its pupil burning with an eternal gray-white flame, as if gazing upon ants or examining a chess piece about to ripen.

dialogue.content: "You have finally accepted this key, Chen Ji." The Heavenly Eye's voice did not come from his ear but exploded directly in his Mental Sea, making his seven orifices throb with pain. "A thousand years of reincarnation, seventeen prophets have fallen, and you are the first ant to dare look directly at my true form."

text.content: Chen Ji endured the churning agony in his Mental Sea, his lips反而 twisting into a cold smile. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's parting words—"What Heaven fears most is not a powerful opponent, but an ant who sees through its cards." At this moment, he had no retreat. Heavenly Fate Value was visibly draining from his Brow Center, each breath feeling like it was burning away his life.

In the distance, the main peak of Tianqing Sect cast a massive shadow in the morning light. Chen Ji knew that at this moment, Su Qingyao was presiding over an urgent meeting in the Inner Sect Hall, and that old fox Ling Yuan was surely watching from the shadows. He had to complete his preparations in the shortest time possible, otherwise what awaited him would be a losing game with no chance of recovery.

dialogue.content: "Since the messenger has descended, surely it's not for pleasantries?" Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his tone as indifferent as discussing the weather. "Speak then—what does Heaven want? And what price must be paid?"

text.content: Above the firmament, that enormous eye slightly narrowed, as if reassessing this servant disciple before it. After a moment, a figure slowly stepped out from the rift—a middle-aged man in plain white robes, his features elegant and otherworldly, yet surrounded by a suffocating aura of chaos. Each of his steps landed on empty space yet felt as steady as walking on solid ground, clearly having transcended mortal limits.

dialogue.content: "This one is called Tai Chu, the emissary of Heaven's will in the mortal realm." The white-robed man slightly inclined his head, his manner gentle yet carrying an arrogant superiority. "The Master says you are most interesting. The first mortal in a thousand years to dare wager against Heaven—itself a form of glory."

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond, simply waiting for what came next. He knew only too well these lofty beings—the more they emphasized glory, the more they needed him to do something. Seeing Chen Ji refuse to take the bait, a flicker of displeasure passed through Tai Chu's eyes, yet he maintained his composed exterior.

dialogue.content: "In three days, the Ancient Forbidden Land 'Tianji Pavilion' will fully open." Tai Chu waved his hand, and a holographic map woven from Heaven's laws materialized before Chen Ji. "There lie the original last three pages of the Tianji Record—if you can seize them from the heart of the forbidden grounds, the contract will be complete. At that time, the Master shall grant you true freedom."

text.content: Freedom? Chen Ji laughed coldly in his heart. Heaven's "freedom" was merely a larger cage. But he revealed nothing on his surface, merely asking indifferently: "And the price? Heaven never makes a losing trade." Tai Chu's smile grew warmer, yet his words cut like ice: "Every use of the Tianji Record's foresight power will now triple the Heavenly Fate consumption. Additionally, there are three other 'competitors' within the forbidden grounds—they too have received the Master's invitation."

dialogue.content: Before Tai Chu's words had finished, three silhouettes materialized in the Void's projection. The first was Ling Yuan—Chen Ji had already guessed that old fox was indeed connected to Heaven. The second was a woman draped in black纱, Ye Qing's sworn enemy, the chief disciple under the Holy Sect Elder's seat. The third... Chen Ji's pupils constricted—it was Su Qingyao in azure robes!

"Su Qingyao? Why would she be here?" For the first time, a tremor appeared in Chen Ji's voice. He had spent years in careful布局, everything under control, yet he never wanted her dragged into this murky mess. Seeing this, Tai Chu's lips curved into a meaningful arc: "She's searching for her missing sister, isn't she? And your sister... happens to also be within the Tianji Pavilion."

text.content: Chen Nian! The name pierced Chen Ji's heart like a blade. Finding his sister was his core objective in Volume Five, yet he never expected Heaven to use this as bait, pulling Su Qingyao into this chess game as well. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. Since things had come to this, retreat was meaningless.

"One final question." Chen Ji stared directly into Tai Chu's eyes, his voice deep as an abyss. "You said there are three competitors in the forbidden grounds—then what of Chen Nian? Is she a piece, or an existence beyond the chessboard?" Tai Chu's smile deepened further, yet he offered no answer, his form gradually becoming transparent, dissolving into scattered starlight in the Void. Before departing, he left behind meaningful words: "The answer will reveal itself in three days."

choice.prompt: Facing the departure of Heaven's messenger, Chen Ji needed to make his first decision—how to seize the initiative in the forbidden grounds conflict three days hence?

choices.description: The Holy Sect Saintess's 'Demonic Path Fog' can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, a key advantage for infiltrating the forbidden grounds. At this moment, he must ensure she stands on his side.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points to foresight Ye Qing's true attitude
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's complete trust, unlocking the 'Demonic Mist Protection' state
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing still harbors divided loyalties, this foresight will expose everything

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and concentrated, the Tianji Record fragments slowly unfurling within his Mental Sea. After a moment, he opened his eyes, a trace of relief flickering in his gaze—Ye Qing's trust toward him ran deeper than he had anticipated. "She will not betray, because she knows better than anyone that without me, she will forever be a discarded pawn of the Holy Sect." He retrieved a communication jade talisman inscribed with a black lotus mark, murmuring softly: "Old friend, it's time to meet."

choices.description: She appears among the competitors, meaning she may have been used or coerced by Heaven. Must first confirm whether she is enemy or ally.
choices.visible_cost: Using the Tianji Record to foresee Su Qingyao's behavior patterns in the Tianqu Pavilion
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's 'insider' support - she will turn against them at a critical moment
choices.risk_hint: The foresight result may show her consciousness being controlled, becoming an enemy

text.content: The foresight vision exploded before Chen Ji's eyes—he saw Su Qingyao gripping a longsword, standing alone against the combined assault of the Holy Sect and Ling Yuan, her blue robes soaked in blood yet her spine unbent. Clutched tightly to her chest was Chen Nian, missing for years! "Senior sister..." Chen Nian's feeble voice pierced through the vision, stabbing at Chen Ji's heart. So Su Qingyao had been secretly searching for his sister all along, landing herself in grave danger for it. "This woman..." Chen Ji clenched his fists, nails digging deep into his palms. "Truly infuriating, yet heart-wrenching."

choices.description: Since that old fox is also a competitor, it means his connection to the Heavenly Dao runs far deeper than imagined. Better to take the initiative and confront him directly—let's see who reveals their hand first.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing that I know Ling Yuan's hidden cards may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan will be forced to reveal some of his strength prematurely, reducing threats in the three-day confrontation
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may ally with other competitors to form an anti-Chen Ji alliance

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flashed, and he appeared at the entrance of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds. Ling Yuan sat cross-legged on a blue stone, as if he had long known Chen Ji would come. "Little Ji, you arrived faster than this old man anticipated." The old sect master opened his eyes, the turbid pupils flashing with keen light. "You've joined the Heavenly Dao's game as well?" Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, a mocking smile on his face: "Old thing, how many years have you knelt before the Heavenly Dao? Has its promised 'inheritance' ever been fulfilled even a little?" Ling Yuan's expression changed drastically, his surrounding aura surged violently, terrifying pressure bearing down like a collapsing mountain—yet Chen Ji remained unmoved. "We shall meet again in three days for the true showdown." He turned and left, leaving only these words: "By then, I will show you what true Heavenly Secrets are."

Only after Taichu's figure completely vanished did Chen Ji slowly exhale a breath of turbid air. The contract seal still burned on his chest, reminding him time was running short. Three days—just three days, and he must integrate all forces to directly clash with the Heavenly Dao's chess game in the Tianqu Pavilion Forbidden Grounds. And this time, he was no longer fighting alone.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you've got quite the nerve." A cold female voice came from behind. The Black Lotus mark on Chen Ji's palm grew warm, and Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows, her eyes carrying both scrutiny and a hint of playfulness. "The Heavenly Dao's messenger descended personally, yet you still dare to stay and wait for death?" She stepped closer, her gaze falling on the faintly glowing contract seal on Chen Ji's chest: "Triple consumption... Are you insane or do you have hidden trump cards?"

"Neither." Chen Ji turned around, meeting Ye Qing's gaze. He noticed the flash of worry in her eyes, and his heart warmed slightly. This Demon Path saintess had a sharp tongue, but she never faltered at critical moments. "I'm waiting for someone—someone who can let me survive this deadly game." He paused, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his mouth: "For instance, you."

text.content: Ye Qing was momentarily stumped by his bluntness, then snorted coldly to cover her embarrassment: "Smooth talker. The Holy Sect has already sent three waves of assassins to intercept me. If not for your 'prophecy' warning me in advance, I'd already be dead bones." She drew a jade slip that glowed with a eerie light from her sleeve and handed it solemnly to Chen Ji: "This is the complete original treatise on the 'Demon Path Mist'—something the Holy Sect pursued me for ten years without obtaining."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji accepted the jade slip, sensing the abundant demonic energy within, yet showing no greed. He merely said calmly: "This thing is useless to me, but I can pass it to someone who needs it." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "For instance?" "For instance, your future disciple, or..." Chen Ji raised his eyes, a sharp glint flickering within: "A girl named Chen Nian. She, like you, is a pitiful soul imprisoned by fate." Ye Qing shuddered, and her gaze toward Chen Ji changed completely—this man was far more terrifying than she imagined, and far more... tender.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing has declared her loyalty; Chen Ji must decide how to deploy this crucial strategic card

choices.text: Have Ye Qing serve as close protection
choices.description: The Demon Path Mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura; with her by my side, Heavenly Dao surveillance in the Forbidden Grounds will be greatly reduced
choices.visible_cost: If encountering Holy Sect experts in the Forbidden Grounds, Ye Qing's identity will be exposed, facing pursuit and assassination
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ji can safely use the Tianji Record three times for foresight within the Forbidden Grounds, with consumption halved
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's direct conflict with the Holy Sect may expose the mastermind behind the scenes

dialogue.content: "Close protection?" Ye Qing's gaze scanned Chen Ji with playful intent, "Aren't you afraid I'll strike at you in the middle of the night?" Chen Ji responded calmly: "If you wanted to kill me, you could have done so half a year ago." Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh, and in that laughter was a rare sense of exhilaration: "Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, you truly are the most interesting madman in this world. Fine, I'll go mad with you to the very end!"

choices.text: Send her to protect Chen Nian
choices.description: From the foresight vision, I know Su Qingyao will appear in the Forbidden Grounds with Chen Nian—must ensure my sister's safety
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji loses the concealment of the Demon Path Mist within the Forbidden Grounds, and Heavenly Fate consumption doubles
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains Demonic Path Mist protection, allowing safe passage to the safe zone.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may conflict with Su Qingyao.

dialogue.content: "Protect a girl I've never even met?" Ye Qing frowned, clearly not expecting him to make such a request. Chen Ji turned around, his voice low yet carrying undeniable force: "Her name is Chen Nian, my younger sister. She was taken by the Holy Sect as a child, raised as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'." He paused, his eyes slightly reddening: "I owe her too much. If possible, I'd rather die in the forbidden grounds myself than let her suffer any more harm." Ye Qing stared at him blankly, and at this moment she suddenly understood something—the seemingly cold-blooded man before her actually harbored such scorching tenderness within his heart.

choices.text: Have her infiltrate the Holy Sect's interior.
choices.description: When the forbidden grounds open, the Holy Sect will inevitably fall into chaos—this is the optimal timing to destroy its foundations.
choices.visible_cost: Once Ye Qing's identity is exposed, she will be branded a traitor by the Holy Sect, with no hope of redemption.
choices.visible_reward: When the forbidden grounds open, the Holy Sect's rear will be left vulnerable, allowing Chen Ji to calmly seize core resources.
choices.risk_hint: May expose the alliance between Chen Ji and Ye Qing.

dialogue.content: After hearing Chen Ji's plan, Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply: "You want me to return as a spy? Once my identity is exposed..." "So I'm not asking you to be a spy, but to be a bomb that can be detonated at any moment." Chen Ji took out a jet-black formation board from his sleeve: "This is the 'Soul-Devouring Formation' I've improved—it can disrupt the Holy Sect elders' perception at critical moments. On the day the forbidden grounds open, you only need to place it at the core of the Holy Temple, and leave the rest to me." Ye Qing stared at him for a long time, then suddenly smiled: "Chen Ji, if you used this brain of yours on the righteous path, you'd have ascended to the immortal realm long ago."

text.content: After arranging Ye Qing's mission, Chen Ji climbed alone to the Stargazing Terrace at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. The night wind whistled fiercely, ruffling his thin robes, but could not disperse the heaviness between his brows. The Tianque Pavilion forbidden grounds three days later would not only be the battlefield for seizing the original Tianji Record, but the key chess game determining the fate of the entire world. And he was about to face the most powerful opponent in a thousand years—not just Ling Yuan, not just the Holy Sect, but the Heavenly Dao itself that controlled everything.

dialogue.content: "What are you thinking about?" The familiar voice came from behind. Chen Ji didn't turn around, because he had long sensed that aura—cold, proud, yet carrying a trace of warmth that was not easily察觉ed. Su Qingyao walked over slowly and stood beside him, her gaze falling upon the distant layered mountains. "The thing you asked me to investigate three days ago, I have some leads." She turned her head, her phoenix eyes flickering with sharp light: "Ling Yuan indeed has a connection to the Heavenly Dao, and... he has already sold the core of the Tianqing Sect's protective mountain formation to Tai Chu in exchange for power."

Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's expression grew heavy. He knew Ling Yuan harbored wolf-like ambitions, but he never expected him to be foolish enough to seek help from the tiger. "What else?" Su Qingyao took a deep breath and took out a blood-stained jade token from her bosom: "I found this in Ling Yuan's secret chamber—it bears the soul imprint of the Holy Sect's Saint." Chen Ji took the jade token, and when his fingertips touched its icy coolness, his pupils contracted violently—it was Ye Qing's life token! "It seems our demonic path ally is more dangerous than we imagined." He coldly smiled and tucked the jade token into his sleeve. "But it doesn't matter, she's already made her choice."

text.content: Su Qingyao quietly watched how he handled things, and her heart grew increasingly complex. This once-ridiculedtrash junior disciple had somehow grown into someone she needed to look up to. But her worry also intensified—being drawn into this deadly game of chess against the Heavenly Dao, could he truly emerge unscathed?

dialogue.content: "Sister, I know what you're worried about." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice softening难得ly. "But some things were destined from the moment I obtained the Tianji Record." He turned around, directly meeting Su Qingyao's eyes: "Three days later at the forbidden grounds, don't go. Both Ling Yuan and the Holy Sect people will be there, and they won't spare anyone connected to me." Su Qingyao coldly laughed: "You think I'd listen to you?" Chen Ji sighed: "I know I can't dissuade you, so..." He took out a warm jade-like protective talisman from his chest and solemnly placed it in her hand: "This is the 'Shared Life Talisman' I condensed using my Heavenly Fate Value. As long as you carry it, it can block a lethal attack for you at a critical moment."

text.content: Su Qingyao lowered her head, gazing at the talisman in her hand, sensing the vast life force within and... Chen Ji's aura. This man was actually protecting her with his own life? She abruptly looked up, only to find Chen Ji had already turned and walked away, leaving her with a slightly desolate back view. "Chen Ji!" She called out to him, her voice trembling slightly. "What... what exactly do you think I am to you?" Chen Ji's footsteps halted, but he didn't turn around: "The only person in this world I don't want to scheme against." The words fell, and his figure vanished into the night.

choice.prompt: The forbidden grounds are about to open in three days, and Chen Ji must make his final decision—this will determine the story's ultimate outcome.

choices.description: Exploit the incomplete BUG of the Tianji Record, detonate the Heavenly Fate Value at the forbidden grounds core, creating a rule loophole so the Heavenly Dao cannot reclaim its power.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming all Heavenly Fate Value (approximately 200 points), Chen Ji will instantly age a hundred years and regress three major cultivation realms.
choices.visible_reward: Cracks appear in the Heavenly Dao's control over this realm, and all imprisoned prophetic souls are freed.
choices.risk_hint: During the process, Chen Ji will be extremely weak, potentially allowing Ling Yuan and others to strike at a vulnerable moment.

dialogue.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the forbidden grounds core, the Heavenly Eye manifested once more, its massive pupil burning with scrutinizing flames. Tai Chu's voice exploded like thunder: "Mortal, you dare oppose me?" Chen Ji threw his head back and laughed, the sound tragic yet wild: "Oppose you? No, Heavenly Dao, you overestimate yourself!" He suddenly detonated all Heavenly Fate Value within his body, transforming into a dazzling pillar of light soaring into the heavens. The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted violently—it sensed it! The rules were collapsing! "Impossible! How can a mere mortal break..." Chen Ji cut it off: "Because I'm not a mortal—I am the variable you overlooked!"

choices.description: Accept the Heavenly Dao's complete inheritance, replacing the old with the new, and become the new executor of Heavenly Dao's will.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all humanity, Chen Ji will become an emotionless order enforcer, bidding a final farewell to Su Qingyao and Ye Qing forever.
choices.visible_reward: Having the power to reshape the laws of heaven and earth, to fundamentally change the injustice of fate
choices.risk_hint: During the process, one might suffer backlash from the remnant consciousness of the Heavenly Dao and become a new puppet

dialogue.content: In the deepest part of the Forbidden Grounds, Chen Ji stood upon the original Tianji Record, sensing the vast heavenly laws contained within. Taichu's figure coalesced once more, but this time no arrogance remained on his face—instead, there was a strange anticipation: 'Make your choice, Chen Ji. Accept the inheritance and become the new Heavenly Dao—or be reduced to ashes.' Chen Ji remained silent for a long moment before finally reaching out, his fingertips touching the cold original Tianji Record. An unprecedented power surged into his Mental Sea—it was... the will of the entire cosmos! 'I choose—' His voice echoed, and far away at the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao's heart suddenly ached with excruciating pain, as if something precious was slipping through her fingers forever.

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record as a medium, to detonate the very essence of one's existence, achieving mutual destruction with the Heavenly Dao's will
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji's existence will be completely erased from history—no one will remember him, and in this world there will be no Chen Ji ever again
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Dao's will is destroyed, the shackles of fate are completely shattered, and all those who were manipulated by fate regain their freedom
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's desperate counterattack might turn the entire Forbidden Grounds and the surrounding hundred miles into ruins

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood at the highest point of the Forbidden Grounds, gazing down at the countless beings beneath his feet. The Eye of the Heavenly Dao gazed at him from the void, its pressure like a mountain. Taichu's voice rang out: 'You have made your choice?' Chen Ji revealed a relieved smile: 'In this life of mine, I schemed against everyone, and was schemed against by fate countless times.' He slowly raised his hand, and the Tianji Record transformed into a dazzling light in his palm: 'But at least in this final moment, I want to let heaven and earth know—a mortal also has the right to rewrite their own destiny!' The light blazed and swallowed the entire Forbidden Grounds, as well as that high-and-mighty Eye of the Heavenly Dao. And far away at the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao suddenly clutched her chest, tears streaming down her face—she didn't know what had happened, only that something infinitely precious was disappearing forever.

text.content: Three days of preparation passed in an instant. When the first light of dawn pierced through the clouds of the Tianqing Sect, the void at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds began to twist violently. The pressure of the Eye of the Heavenly Dao descended once more—this time not merely observation, but tangible oppression. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back on the Stargazing Platform, gazing into the distance at the gradually forming rift, a faint, serene curve on his lips. Behind him stood Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and even the phantom image of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, all standing in silence. In this battle, he was no longer alone. And in his heart, he already had the answer—regardless of which path he chose, he would make those who secretly manipulated fate know: the strength of an ant can also shake the heavens!
